original_tile.description: A terracotta board has been painted with ochre and ground iron.

source_features: Terracotta board, two pale supports visible above/below, stepped top/bottom edging and graveyard pictogram encoded in negative source spaces.

palette.primary: y from nonempty TileColor override, on two supports
palette.text_fallback: ColorString r applies text fallback, not tile-primary y
palette.rule: Neutral source-role masks and one coverage; do not import donor colors.

native_behavior.scope: Keep native Chat/SmartuseLooks/furniture behavior. To graveyard and shrine is chat text, not literal tile lettering.

glyph_translation.method: Source negative-space cells become very dark matte paint/recess-like marks on a continuous physical clay face.
glyph_translation.coverage_change: Those glyph spaces gain opaque dark-painted coverage in the authored solid board. They are not literal cut-through holes: painted-board metadata guides this physical translation. Native palette codes and one-coverage rendering are preserved, not the exact binary16x24 icon alpha.
glyph_translation.not_new_text: No invented To graveyard and shrine lettering or invented graveyard detail.

donor_reference.mod: Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Props and Decor
donor_reference.role: Actual installed standing sign supplies restrained board/support edge convention. Do not copy its single post, wood material, tilt or stone base.

authored_interpretation: One continuous beveled terracotta plaque with source-bound edging, two rear uprights and front-only matte pictogram. Hidden thickness and join placement are authored.

view_contract.south: Source plaque and dark source-positioned pictogram; rear supports show above/below and are occluded behind solid face.
view_contract.east: Actual thin plaque edge and rear support offset; no independently compressed panel.
view_contract.north: Blank clay back with the two actual rear uprights; no cloned or mirrored front pictogram.
view_contract.production: One native fixed map tile; retained E/N exports are authoring views only.
view_contract.scale: One16x24 source cell,512x768 manual,256square recipient, anchor8,16. Shared physical scale/pivot/camera.

physical_shape_reuse.reason: Original visible source roles and alpha match outside front pictogram field (transparent RGB canonicalized); same painted-board metadata and palette. Reuse complete physical plaque/uprights/camera; replace only own glyph.
